summary: Everforth Inc filed an 8-K reporting entry into the Third Amendment to its credit agreement, increasing revolving commitments from $500M to $600M, extending maturity to July 7, 2031, and amending interest rates and financial covenants. Proceeds repaid existing term A loans. Obligations are secured by substantially all assets and guaranteed by material domestic subsidiaries. This is a routine financing refinement with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring.
